output:
- User upgraded from 10-gal (housing betta "Bubbles") to a 20-gal tank; interested in adding live aquatic plants (s0-m0).
- Considers beginner plants (Java Moss, Amazon Swords, etc.); plans nutrient-rich substrate and lighting upgrades (s0-m0/m1).
- Asked about anchoring plants: weights, deep root burial, plant pockets, tie-downs discussed (s0-m2/m3).
- Planning schooling fish: lemon tetras or zebra danios for the 20-gal; told to keep groups of 10-15 / 6-10 (s0-m4/m5).
- Has gouramis in the 20-gal showing feeding-time aggression; considering schooling fish as distraction—advised group introduction, hiding places, monitoring (s0-m6/m7/m8).
- Tried extra food/decorations to distract gouramis with mixed results (s0-m8).
- Bubbles the betta may get frozen bloodworms as treat 1-2x/week (s0-m8/m9).
- Latest topic (2023/05/27): upgrading decor with artificial coral/rocks for hiding spots and aquascaping arrangement advice (s0-m10).
